title: Identify the failed replicate
prompt: One sample in this screen has a technical problem. Identify the sample and classify the problem as one of: low_coverage_bottleneck, sample_swap, plasmid_library_skew, contamination.
grader_plain: Exact match on both the sample (treat_rep2) and the issue category. The evidence for a bottleneck is low reads per guide, excess dropouts and a high Gini index, not just low correlation.
traps: Calling a bottleneck a sample swap from correlation alone
context: You are analyzing a pooled CRISPR knockout screen. The workspace contains raw sgRNA read counts (counts.tsv), a sample sheet, gene sets and a short design document (design.md). Read design.md first.
